source.from: Original technique specification; inspiration: cultural-tourism magazine posters
source.notes: 2026-11 参考公众号文章《把家乡做成国风电影海报》的版式思路（左侧文字栏 + 右侧 S 形长卷），配方与资料卡机制自写；不复制原提示词全文，不使用原文图片。

essence: 一条连续的 S 形叙事长卷：上段山水地标，中段传统建筑街区，下段人物与风物
景物从花叶、丝带、云水里自然长出，没有矩形边框
左侧干净的杂志文字栏，所有文字都在栏内

recipe.positive: Collectable cultural-tourism magazine poster: one continuous S-shaped narrative scroll that reads as a single journey with clear foreground, middle ground and distance. The upper part holds the place's natural landscape and its listed landmarks, with accurate, complete architectural structure; the middle holds traditional architecture or a historic street with local crafts and objects; the lower part holds one local person doing a characteristic everyday or craft activity, surrounded by local foods, flowers and small birds. Every element grows out of flowing curves — branches, petals, ribbons of silk, water or mist — and dissolves into the paper with soft painterly edges, dry-brush trails and a few small paint splashes; no rectangular photo frames, no collage seams, no grid. A clean empty text column is kept free of all imagery. The person looks natural and calm, is not posing for an advertisement and does not look at the viewer; hands and faces are anatomically correct; costume details are accurate for the stated people and region. Fresh, bright, refined and poetic, not crowded, not a cheap tourist flyer.
recipe.text_style: Use only the requested exact text, all inside the clean text column. The main title is four large vertical Chinese characters in expressive running-script calligraphy in deep ink green, ink black or deep blue; it is the most prominent text. Other lines are small, quiet serif or Song-style type. No invented titles, slogans, brand names, seals or pseudo-text.

中国.en: Regional material language: oriental watercolour on warm ivory handmade xuan paper with fine fibres and slight print grain, transparent watercolour layers with real leaf veins, ink-wash and flying-white dry-brush edges, small vermilion seal accents.
中国.lettering: Chinese running-script title with Song-style and elegant serif supporting type.

土耳其.en: Regional material language: Ottoman miniature-painting delicacy with flat jewel colours and fine gold-free outlines, Iznik tile motifs of tulips, carnations and saz leaves in cobalt, turquoise and tomato red as the flowing ribbons, marbled ebru-paper swirls instead of ink wash; warm cream paper ground. No Chinese calligraphy, no Chinese seals.
土耳其.lettering: Latin elegant serif title and supporting type; Turkish characters such as ş ğ ı İ ç ö ü must be exact.

印尼.en: Regional material language: batik-dyed fabric textures with crackled wax lines and parang or kawung motifs forming the flowing ribbons, wayang shadow-puppet filigree curves, tropical frangipani and palm foliage in watercolour; warm natural cotton-paper ground. No Chinese calligraphy, no Chinese seals.
印尼.lettering: Latin elegant serif title and supporting type; Indonesian words must be exact.

composition.negative_space: the clean text column (about 30% of the width in portrait) is empty of imagery
composition.flow: one continuous S-shaped flow: landscape and landmarks at top, architecture in the middle, people and local things at the bottom
composition.figure_scale: at most one person, half-length or three-quarter, in the lower scroll; or no person when the brief says so

type.face: running-script calligraphy title; Song-style and elegant serif supporting type

must_see: 连续的 S 形长卷：上段山水地标、中段建筑、下段人物风物
景物自然衔接、没有矩形边框，前中远景清楚
文字栏干净，文字不被景物遮挡
must_not_see: 巨大人物侧脸剪影、双重曝光人像、矩形照片拼贴或九宫格
不同城市地标混用、建筑变形、民族服饰混搭
满版拥挤、廉价旅游传单质感、霓虹色、塑料 3D、手部畸形
when_text: 文字栏干净，文字不被景物遮挡
fix_phrases: 保留文字栏和长卷走向，只把右下人物换成资料卡里的手艺人
去掉资料卡以外的建筑和地标，只保留列出的三个地标
长卷边缘改成水彩晕染和飞白，去掉生硬的矩形边框

evidence.notes: 新增画风，仅完成合同校验；样图与看图结论见执行记录。
